nominal_code.description:
Nominal accounts are fundamental to the successful management of company finances. The value of every transaction entered into Sage 200 is posted to a nominal account and, is where the revenue and expenditure of the business is recorded.

Nominal accounts include a code, and cost centre and a department.

The API endpoint returns details of the nominal codes that can be used.

cost_centre_id.description: Nominal code cost centre record Id.

nominal_account_type.description: The type of the nominal code. (Sage 200 Professional only).

account_status_type.description: The status of the nominal code (Sage 200 Standard and versions of Professional released after February 2018). For example, this can either be 'Active' or 'Hidden'.

report_category_id.description: Financial report category record Id. This is ignored when the nominal account type is Group (Sage 200 Professional only).

display_balances_in_selection_list.description: Whether balances for the nominal code can be shown in selection lists.

balance_year_to_date.description: The nominal account balance, if balances can be shown for the nominal account.

debit_balance_year_to_date.description: The debit balance year to date.

credit_balance_year_to_date.description: The credit balance year to date.

brought_forward_balance.description: The nominal account brought forward balance, if balances can be shown for the nominal account.

allow_manual_journal_entries.description: Determines if manual journals can be entered using this nominal code. This is ignored when the nominal account type is Group (Sage200 Professional only).

use_batch_postings.description: Determines if batch postings are to be made on this account when updating waiting postings. This is ignored when the nominal account type is Group (Sage200 Professional only).

periods_to_keep_transactions.description: Number of periods to keep transactions. This is ignored when the nominal account type is Group (Sage200 Professional only).

consolidated_nominal_account_number.description: Consolidated nominal account number. This is ignored when the nominal account type is Memo or Group (Sage200 Professional only).

consolidated_nominal_cost_centre.description: Consolidated nominal cost centre. This is ignored when the nominal account type is Memo or Group (Sage200 Professional only).

consolidated_nominal_department.description: Consolidated nominal department. This is ignored when the nominal account type is Memo or Group (Sage200 Professional only).

financial_years.description: The financial year breakdown where budgets can be entered and period balances can be viewed.

memos.description:
Memos are sections of text that can be used to make comments about a nominal code.

Multiple memos can be added to each nominal code. The user that created the memo, the date it was created and last updated date and time are also recorded.

A user can also specify if a memo is currently 'Active' or 'Inactive'. This allows a user to keep a record of previous memos without deleting them.

date_time_created.description: The date and time this entity was created (UTC).

date_time_updated.description: The date and time this entity was last updated (UTC).

nominal_code_view.description: This resource returns the details of all nominal codes. The default sort (orderby) fields are by 'reference', 'cost_centre_code' and 'department_code' ascending.

cost_centre_id.description: Nominal code cost centre record Id.

year_value_budget_value.description: The budget value for the current year.

year_value_original_budget_value.description: The original budget value for the current year.

report_category_budget_name.description: The budget name for the current year.

use_batch_postings.description: Determines if batch postings are to be made on this account when updating waiting postings.

periods_to_keep_transactions.description: Number of periods to keep transactions.

Memos are sections of text that can be used to make comments about a nominal code.

Multiple memos can be added to each nominal code. The user that created the memo, the date it was created and last updated date and time are also recorded.

A user can also specify if a memo is currently 'Active' or 'Inactive'. This allows a user to keep a record of previous memos without deleting them.

is_active.description: True if memo status is active, false if it is inactive.

is_to_delete.description: When updating an existing nominal code, whether to delete this memo from the collection of nominal code memos.

created_by.description: The user that created the memo.

nominal_code_financial_year.description: The financial year breakdown for a nominal code where budgets can be entered and period balances can be viewed.

financial_year_id.description:
An Id specific to each financial year.

If setting budget values for a brand new nominal code, this property can be omitted. For existing nominal codes, it is required.

year_relative_to_current_year.description:
Value to represent the year relative to the current financial year. The current financial year is 0. The first previous year is -1. The first future year is 1.

Note: If setting values for a brand new nominal code, this property must be set as the financial_year_id will be 0.

budget_type.description: The budget type. This can be set for any current or future year. NOTE: future years can't use profiled budgets.

budget_value.description: The yearly budget value. If the budget type is NoBudgets, Monthly or Group, then this value will be ignored.

adjustment_after_year_end_close.description: The total value of any adjustments made to the nominal code after the financial year was closed.

closing_balance.description: The closing balance of the nominal code after the financial year was closed.

period_balances.description: A collection of periods for a financial year where budgets can be entered and period balances can be viewed.

date_time_created.description: The date and time this entity was created (UTC).

date_time_updated.description: The date and time this entity was last updated (UTC).

nominal_code_period_balance.description: A single period of a nominal code's financial year where budgets can be entered and balances can be viewed.

period_number.description:
The period number.

If setting values for a brand new nominal code, this property must be set as the Id will be 0.

budget_value.description: The period budget value. NOTE: if the yearly budget type is set as NoBudgets, Group or Factor (profiled budgets), then this value will be ignored.

adjustment_after_year_end_close.description: The total value of any adjustments made to the nominal code after the financial year was closed.

is_future_period.description: If the period's status is Future, then true; otherwise false.

date_time_created.description: The date and time this entity was created (UTC).

date_time_updated.description: The date and time this entity was last updated (UTC).

active.description: Boolean indicating whether the transaction analysis code is active.

date_time_updated.description: The date and time this entity was last updated (UTC).

nominal_period_value_view.description: This resource returns the details of all accounting period nominal values for all financial years held for the company. A company always has five future financial years and can have unlimited previous years, depending on how long the company has been operating. The default sort (orderby) field are by 'accounting_period_end_date', 'accounting_period_period_number' and 'nominal_code_id' descending.

accounting_period_period_number.description: Value to show the period in relation to the associated year. For example, for a year that starts in January, January will be period 1, February period 2 etc.

accounting_period_start_date.description: Date the period starts. The returned string includes the time but this will always be 00:00:00.

accounting_period_end_date.description: Date the period finished. The returned string includes the time but this will always be 00:00:00.

financial_year_id.description: An Id specific to each financial year.

number_of_periods_in_year.description: The number of periods in the financial year.

nominal_report_category.description: Nominal report categories are used in financial statements (PL, Balance Sheet) to group nominal codes under headings and to determine whether the nominal code value is reported on the layout for the Balance Sheet (Asset and Liability) or Profit and Loss (Income and Expense).

account_report_category_type.description: The type of the report category.

nominal_ledger_settings.description:
The Nominal Ledger settings are used to configure application behaviour with respect to the Nominal Ledger module.

Settings include whether to include additional nominal transaction information for each transaction that is entered.

allow_additional_trans_analysis.description: Whether to include additional nominal transaction information for each transaction that is entered.

months_to_keep_transactions.description:
If nominal transactions should be kept, the number of periods they should be retained.

The value should be in the range 0-36.
